sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232433 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $30 a night per site (group sites $75), plus recreation.gov's administrative fee when reserved. $15 a night with a Senior or Access pass. Shenandoah charges $30 per vehicle to enter, valid one week.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232433 (fee description; notice 'There is a $30 fee per vehicle to enter the park. The pass issued is valid for one week') + /rates (2026 Peak Season Apr 29 - Nov 1: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30)

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232433 ('$15.00 per night/per site with an Access (disability/golden age) or Senior Pass')

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232433 (notice: 'There are no RV hook-ups but there is a dump station with potable water available')

values.note: Pay showers at the Loft Mountain Campstore (2026: open April 29 - November 1; food, gifts, camping supplies). Firewood may not be on sale after 5 p.m.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232433 (Facilities: 'flush toilets and water and dump stations ... Pay showers are nearby at the campstore') + https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/hours.htm (Loft Mountain Campstore, mile 79.5)

values.note: 2026 dates (April 29 to November 1) from NPS's campground table; dates are set each year.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/hours.htm (Campgrounds table: Loft Mountain 2026 opening April 29, closing November 1; last updated 2026-09-22)

values.note: Campsites by reservation and first-come, first-served. Reservable sites release in waves: 50% six months before arrival, 25% two weeks before, the remaining 25% four days before. Walk-up sites are claimed in person at the ranger station and typically sell out on weekends ('seldom any available by Saturday'); text SHENCAMP to 888777 for availability alerts.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/campground-reservations.htm + https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/hours.htm ('Campsites by reservation and first-come, first-served') + rec.gov walk-up notice

values.note: 202 sites in the recreation.gov catalog (155 standard, 44 tent-only, 3 group), 145 reservable and 57 walk-up, plus 11 management sites; the description says 207. Most standard sites are pull-throughs listing 30-40 ft; the longest lists 55.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232433 (fetched 2026-10-20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232433 description

summary: Confirmed $30 base and water false. Added no hookups (electric 0, sewer false), Senior/Access $15, $30/week park entrance, 2026 season Apr 29-Nov 1, reservation plus first-come (some_sites) with the 6-month/2-week/4-day release waves, flush toilets/water/dump/pay showers/campstore, 202 sites up to 55 ft with pull-throughs. Not stated in prose: max stay (rec.gov rule field says 30 nights a year, not written), laundry.
